rationale:
Issue #704 reports a formatting regression in which a parenthesized multiline map literal forces `.forEach` onto its own line. The production fix in `lib/src/call_chain_visitor.dart` unwraps `ParenthesizedExpression` inside `_forcesSplit` before the existing collection-literal checks, which is exactly the reported cause: the target's parentheses hid the collection literal from the no-split rule. The removed TODO line `// * ParenthesizedExpression.` is the item the hunk implements, not an unrelated edit; the minimized patch is that single hunk only, with CHANGELOG.md correctly excluded from it. Triggers are the upstream fixtures from the same commit: `test/regression/0700/0704.unit` reproduces the issue body's code verbatim with the expected unsplit output, and the new case in `test/splitting/invocations.stmt` exercises nested parentheses over an unsplittable list target. Neither depends on any new production API; `_forcesSplit` is private and the fixtures are driven by the pre-existing `test/formatter_test.dart` harness. Strict evidence for both original and post-minimization runs shows build passing on both revisions, both declared selectors failing on the buggy revision (`trigger.buggy_differential`, `full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers`), fixed revision fully green, deterministic across 3 repetitions with no failed checks. `active_same_project_root_causes` is empty, so this root cause duplicates no registry entry, and `dart-lang/dart_style#704` is the supplied allowed key.

Issue #704 reports a behavioral regression: code that formerly kept `.forEach(...)` on the same line as the closing `})` of a parenthesized map literal began emitting a forced split before `.` as of release 1.1.0, i.e. a pre-existing defect rather than a missing feature. The minimized production patch touches exactly one method, CallChainVisitor._forcesSplit, adding a while-loop that unwraps ParenthesizedExpression before the existing collection-literal checks, and deletes only the now-obsolete TODO bullet naming ParenthesizedExpression as unhandled. That is a single behavioral hunk with no refactor, formatting, config, or docs content; CHANGELOG.md and the fixtures are excluded from the minimized patch. The triggers are the upstream fixtures from the same fixing commit: test/regression/0700/0704.unit reproduces the issue body verbatim with the expected unsplit output, and the new invocations.stmt case `((([element,]))).someLongMethod();` exercises the same parenthesis-unwrapping root cause. Both are data fixtures consumed by the pre-existing test/formatter_test.dart harness, so they introduce no dependency on any production API added by the fix. Strict evidence records both original and post-minimization gates passing, including build.both_versions, trigger.buggy_differential with both selectors reproduced, trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic (4 fingerprint groups), full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, full_suite.fixed_all_green, and matrix.complete at 38 runs with 3 repetitions. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and dart-lang/dart_style#704 is the sole allowed verified issue key, so the root cause is not a duplicate.
